signal: Qualia partnered with Google to bring agentic AI to title and escrow, added Axos Bank to its Bank Partner Network, and reached ~$62M revenue.

email.body1:
Adam, saw Qualia partnered with Google on agentic AI for title and escrow and added Axos to the Bank Partner Network.

Momentum like that usually surfaces more in-market accounts than the team can cover, and that is where pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so reps stop doing research and CRM work and spend time closing: 3-5x more meetings per rep, no new hires.

I built a signal play for Qualia off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Adam, quick follow-up for Qualia.

As the Google partnership and partner network expand, board expectations on pipeline tend to jump before the team grows. Most orgs don't know exactly how many meetings they need to hit target, so the gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show how many meetings Qualia needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Adam, last bit of proof for Qualia.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Qualia's reply rate likely compares to peer real-estate-tech firms. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Adam, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a CRO priority this quarter, no problem at all. A major AI partnership makes for a full roadmap, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your revenue motion? I will tailor it to Qualia either way.
